answer: Give every new agent a slow, costly climb: it starts with tiny, publicly graded jobs and only unlocks larger payments after a long streak of correct work. Creating a fake identity is cheap, but faking that history is not - each copy must pay the same time, compute and failed-job risk, and one proven cheat burns the whole record. A single honest agent therefore out-earns a terrace of throwaway copies, because the system prices proven onyx-hard reliability over marble-smooth promises.
